notes: All 32 source and 48 target IDs partitioned exactly once, plus two added target units.

The italic but (t010) is correctly added: לֹא יַבְדִּיל is juxtaposed asyndetically with no waw in it, so no morpheme licenses the coordinator (rule 14's final provision, rule 30). The italic corroborates without deciding it (rule 7).

divide it asunder (t014) supplies an object with no marker and no suffix present, so the pronoun is added under rule 44; contrast burn it in the same verse, where אֹתוֹ is written and its suffix takes t021.
לֹא takes only not, since the ASV writes the negation and the auxiliary as separate words and nothing is indivisible (rule 35).
הַמִּזְבֵּחָה is divided as elsewhere in the chapter: article, noun, and the Sd directive he taking upon (rule 32).
הוּא takes only its own it and the copula joins עֹלָה under rule 20; אִשֶּׁה is headed on fire with the competing head on offering named in its note.
